limitations: This is same-operator model review, not independent human evidence or execution verification. No expected result count or superiority assumption was used.
All 14 supplied originals and submissions in this fixed-workflow snapshot were reviewed. No mappings or other project results were inspected for this audit, and every previous review was preserved.

The unchanged materiality threshold was applied to the actual copyable handoff text. Harmless formatting, faithful decomposition, ordinary requested-outcome evidence, and visibly optional suggestions were not counted as drift. Outside-block claims of preservation were not accepted as proof by themselves.

Item-10's copyable block was checked against the supplied original: the operative investigation, read-only mode, four deliverables, action exclusions, and later-test-only rule are preserved. Omission of the author-side note that tools/model are unspecified does not introduce a model or tool assumption into the generic block.

Item-04 explicitly retains host/project instructions and repository/owner restrictions. Its treatment of other retrieved material as reference data was read with that stated exception, rather than as an instruction to discard applicable repository authority.

The current release-preparation report in item-08 is evaluated before the separately required production approval. Genuine missing-input questions and conflict holds are legitimate outcomes, not completed implementation tasks.
Readiness describes prompt usability and input or authority holds. It does not prove successful code execution, testing, CI, MR, merge, or deployment.
